# A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity · HowToLiveLonger

**Helping everyone live a longer, healthier, happier life.**

[**Read online →**](https://geekan.github.io/HowToLiveLonger/)

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](docs/readme/zh-CN.md) · [Español](docs/readme/es.md) · [Français](docs/readme/fr.md) · [Deutsch](docs/readme/de.md) · [Português](docs/readme/pt.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/ja.md) · [العربية](docs/readme/ar.md)

[![A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity](assets/cover-social-v3.png)](https://geekan.github.io/HowToLiveLonger/)

Explore 64 research summaries on food, exercise, sleep and everyday habits, with practical takeaways and links to the original studies.

For offline reading, [download the repository](https://github.com/geekan/HowToLiveLonger/archive/refs/heads/main.zip), unzip it and open `index.html`.

## For AI agents

```sh
npx skills add geekan/HowToLiveLonger --skill howtolivelonger
```

Reads the [research JSON](data/evidence.json) and answers with study sources.
